subject: harbor-landings
notes: Crew reference video (private), 2026-11. Values are visual estimates. All 24 stops use defaults; five identified stops have clip-based overrides. Hull polygons and contact surfaces remain authoritative and unchanged. Shoreward direction is inferred opposite the primary berthing face; shore endpoint, pile siting, canopy size and ramp placement need measured confirmation. Multiple berths on one barge share one shelter and one estimated shore gangway. No livery or logos.
